description: Observed-order-of-accuracy sweep for grids/column_nonuniform_1d/rules/varcoeff_face_laplacian_lev_flux_bc driven by problems/heat_column_varcoeff_flux_bc.esm (constant interface coefficient alpha, prescribed nonzero K du/dz at both interfaces). The problem file is loaded once per resolution with the loader-API metaparameter binding (esm-spec 9.7.6 binding site 4). The manufactured solution z + exp(-alpha pi^2 t) cos(pi z) is exact for the continuous PDE; the ramp is discretely exact, so the recorded L2 errors at t=0.1 are the cosine mode's spatial error and are expected to reproduce tests/conformance/convergence/heat_1d_nonuniform_neumann's golden to round-off (cross-grid consistency of the column rule with the cartesian one), falling as O(dz^2).
